summary: Master public sector digital service delivery with citizen-centred design, service dashboards, and practical improvement tools. Enrol to improve delivery.
lede: Digital service delivery training for public-sector professionals covers assessing current services and redesigning them around user needs. Operations, digital transformation, policy and frontline service teams practice journey mapping, service blueprints, queue analysis and KPI dashboards to identify friction and plan improvements. They also develop workflow plans, channel transition strategies and governance controls, then report progress through service scorecards and improvement briefs.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who need to improve public service delivery using practical tools, measurable service data, and citizen-centred methods. It fits teams working across operations, digital transformation, governance, policy, and frontline service design.
prerequisites: You should bring a laptop for workshop activities and be ready to work with sample service data, service journey templates, and improvement planning tools. If possible, prepare one current public service challenge, one performance report, or one process map from your organisation so you can apply the exercises to a real case.
